description: This file defines the Chromium class extending BrowserType, managing Chromium browser instances, including connection over CDP, handling Selenium hub, and startup configurations for the Playwright project.

classes.name: Chromium
classes.description: Represents the Chromium browser type with methods for connection, startup, and error handling.

methods.name: connectOverCDP
methods.description: Establishes a connection to a Chromium instance over the Chrome DevTools Protocol.

methods.name: _connectOverCDPInternal
methods.description: Internal method to handle CDP connection setup, including headers and transport.

methods.name: _createDevTools
methods.description: Creates a CRDevTools instance for debugging.

methods.name: connectToTransport
methods.description: Connects to a Chromium browser instance via a transport layer.

methods.name: doRewriteStartupLog
methods.description: Rewrites startup error logs for better clarity, especially sandbox errors.

methods.name: amendEnvironment
methods.description: Modifies environment variables for launching Chromium.

methods.name: attemptToGracefullyCloseBrowser
methods.description: Sends a command to close the browser gracefully.

methods.name: defaultArgs
methods.description: Generates default command-line arguments for launching Chromium.

methods.name: _innerDefaultArgs
methods.description: Helper to assemble command-line arguments based on options.

methods.name: waitForReadyState
methods.description: Waits for the browser to be ready, retrieving WebSocket endpoint if available.

methods.name: getExecutableName
methods.description: Returns the executable name based on options like channel and headless mode.
